@dekodesign: By doing so you hardcode the index used for the initial search. This will mitigate the issue, but will not completely fix it. You'll be able to change the currently selected index using the dropdown, but if you then share the url, it will not "remember" the selected index and will always revert to the one hardcoded.

I don't currently have a Mac to reproduce and fix this. I'll have a look start of January.
